entities.summary: The St. Francis Roman Catholic Church is a diocese of the Latin Church of the Roman Catholic Church in Hpa-An, Kayin State. The diocese was erected on January 24, 2009 from the Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Yangon. The current bishop of the diocese is Stanislaus Min Ko, who succeeded Justin Saw Min Thide, the first bishop of the Diocese, on 26 March 2026.
